hero.heading: Material interfaces for a sustainable future.
hero.definition: The thin boundary where materials meet.

how_i_work.heading: I solve problems.
how_i_work.text: I connect molecular behaviour to mechanisms and measurable material response through simulation, theory and experimental validation.
how_i_work.question: Does shaking help water freeze?
how_i_work.answer: It depends on how you shake it.

how_i_work.heading: I make work easier.
how_i_work.text: I build reusable simulation workflows and analysis tools, and automate large simulation campaigns on national computing systems.
how_i_work.question: How do scattered tasks become a repeatable workflow?
how_i_work.answer: A clear sequence makes repeated work easier.

how_i_work.heading: I help others understand.
how_i_work.text: I explain complex results through scientific visualisation, presentations and mentoring.
how_i_work.question: How can a complex idea become easy to understand?
how_i_work.answer: Residence time is the average time something stays in a place before leaving.

about.text: My research connects surface design, adhesion and ice nucleation. I combine molecular simulation, laboratory experiments and scientific computing to understand interfaces and address practical environmental questions.
